name: Sidecar Bar
notes: Bar (no kitchen/food menu found on own site) - first-party drink menu embedded directly in the restaurant's own site (SpotHopper platform), 144 priced items across 16 sections (Bottles and Cans, Seltzers, Kombucha, Non-Alcoholic, Wines, House Cocktails, Whiskey, Gin, Vodka, Rum, Tequila, Mezcal, Brandy, Liqeuers/Schnapps, Amaro/Apertif, SLUSHEEZ). Draft Beers section deliberately has no priced items ('CHECK OUT OUR DRAFT LIST AT THE BAR!' placeholder - rotates daily, correctly dropped rather than invented). Vermouths section items are cocktail ingredients with no standalone price, correctly dropped. A separate 'SPIRITS & COCKTAILS'/'BOTTLES & CANS'/'MERCH' block is an unrelated clearance-sale stub, all items literally 'COMING SOON!', correctly excluded. Conventional whole/half-dollar bar pricing throughout, no markup signature. Address on page (Morena Blvd, San Diego, CA 92110) matches batch.
